Exam Fee Collection Summary
query: SELECT sfa.status, COUNT(sfa.name) as total_records, SUM(sfa.total_amount) as total_amount, SUM(sfa.paid_amount) as paid_amount, SUM(sfa.balance) as pending_amount FROM `tabStudent Fee Assignment` sfa WHERE sfa.fee_type = 'Exam' GROUP BY sfa.status

name: Exam Attendance Summary
query: SELECT ea.exam_schedule, ea.subject, ea.exam_date, ea.student_group, COUNT(ea.name) as total_students, SUM(CASE WHEN ea.status = 'Present' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as present_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ea.status = 'Absent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as absent_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ea.status = 'Malpractice' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as malpractice_count FROM `tabExam Attendance` ea GROUP BY ea.exam_schedule ORDER BY ea.exam_date DESC

name: Exam Result Summary
query: SELECT ar.exam_schedule, es.subject, es.exam_date, ar.student_group, COUNT(ar.name) as total_results, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.grade != 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.grade = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fail_count, AVG(ar.total_score) as average_score, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.is_published = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as published_count FROM `tabAssessment Result` ar LEFT JOIN `tabExam Schedule` es ON es.name = ar.exam_schedule WHERE ar.exam_schedule IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ar.exam_schedule ORDER BY es.exam_date DESC

name: Promotion Summary
query: SELECT sp.name as promotion_batch, sp.program, sp.academic_year, sp.current_semester, sp.next_semester, sp.status, COUNT(spd.name) as total_students, SUM(CASE WHEN spd.eligible = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as eligible_count, SUM(CASE WHEN spd.decision = 'Promote' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as promoted_count, SUM(CASE WHEN spd.decision = 'Hold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as held_count, SUM(CASE WHEN spd.decision = 'Repeat Semester' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as repeat_count FROM `tabStudent Promotion` sp LEFT JOIN `tabStudent Promotion Detail` spd ON spd.parent = sp.name GROUP BY sp.name ORDER BY sp.creation DESC
